comments.story: Ray: A Distributed Framework for Emerging AI Applications
comments.why: Intro to AI capabilities coming to Elixir
comments.text: Although it's early days, José Valim and some other folks are working on adding AI-related capabilities to Elixir and the (Erlang) BEAM. See "Introducing Nx" ( [VIDEO] ) for an intro. Given that they already have a robust Actor model as a base to work from, it occurs to me that they may be able to use some of Ray's ideas as they go along...
